command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
& git fetch origin main --no-tags --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "baseline fetch failed"}
$observed=(& git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main).Trim()
if($observed -ne "ce51aa2804902990776071293990dad48a4ed1f1"){throw "main moved before baseline capture: $observed"}
$dirty=@(& git status --short)
if($dirty.Count -ne 0){throw "persistent checkout is dirty before baseline capture: $($dirty -join '; ')"}
& git switch main
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "could not switch persistent checkout to main"}
& git pull --ff-only origin main
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "could not fast-forward persistent main"}
if((& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne "ce51aa2804902990776071293990dad48a4ed1f1"){throw "baseline checkout head mismatch"}
$exe=Join-Path $repo "out\winui\Release\FlyExplorer.exe"
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)){throw "BASELINE_RELEASE_MISSING=$exe"}
$evidence=Join-Path $repo "logs\remote-evidence"
$fixture=Join-Path $evidence "search-content-regex-before-fixture"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $fixture | Out-Null
$script=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "capture-search-content-regex-before.py"
@'
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c
import ctypes.wintypes as w
import subprocess, sys, time
from PIL import ImageGrab
from pywinauto import Desktop

exe=Path(sys.argv[1])
fixture=Path(sys.argv[2])
out=Path(sys.argv[3])
proc=subprocess.Popen([str(exe), str(fixture)], cwd=str(exe.parent))
hwnd=None
try:
    desk=Desktop(backend="uia")
    deadline=time.time()+20
    win=None
    while time.time()<deadline:
        wins=desk.windows(process=proc.pid)
        if wins:
            win=wins[0]
            try:
                if win.exists(timeout=0.2) and win.is_visible():
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass
        time.sleep(0.25)
    if win is None:
        raise RuntimeError("baseline FlyExplorer window not found")
    hwnd=win.handle
    panel=win.child_window(auto_id="SearchPanelButton")
    if not panel.exists(timeout=5):
        raise RuntimeError("SearchPanelButton not found")
    panel.click_input()
    scope=win.child_window(auto_id="SearchScopeBox")
    if not scope.exists(timeout=5):
        raise RuntimeError("SearchScopeBox not visible after opening search panel")
    time.sleep(0.5)
    rect=win.rectangle()
    ImageGrab.grab(
        bbox=(rect.left,rect.top,rect.right,rect.bottom),
        all_screens=True,
    ).save(out)
    print(f"SEARCH_CONTENT_REGEX_BEFORE_SCREENSHOT={out}", flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        if hwnd:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(w.HWND(hwnd),0x10,0,0)
        try:
            proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill()
            proc.wait(timeout=5)
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding UTF8
$shot=Join-Path $evidence "search-content-regex-before.png"
& python -X utf8 $script $exe $fixture $shot
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "baseline screenshot capture failed"}
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $shot -PathType Leaf)){throw "baseline screenshot missing"}
Write-Host "BASELINE_PRODUCT_REVISION=ce51aa2804902990776071293990dad48a4ed1f1"
Write-Host "BASELINE_VISUAL=PASS"
